question: Through which of the following places does the Standard Meridian of India pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirzapur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Standard Meridian of India** passes through **Mirzapur**.
 
• The longitude of the Standard Meridian is **82.5° E**, which is used as the reference for Indian Standard Time (IST).
 
• Mirzapur is located in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• This meridian helps in maintaining a uniform time zone across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Standard Time (IST) is **5 hours and 30 minutes** ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT+5:30).
 
• Having a standard meridian helps in avoiding confusion and ensuring that the entire country follows the same time.
 
• The concept of a standard time zone is crucial for the synchronization of activities, especially in a country as vast as India.
